import hashlib,json,math,struct
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/lilleap/code/rsWordLayout'); out=root/'artifacts/vertical-precision-2026-09-22'
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ev=json.loads((out/'evaluation-01.json').read_text()); inp=json.loads((root/'fixtures/vertical-precision.font-inputs.json').read_text())
fonts={f['family']:f for f in inp['fonts']};q=lambda value,g=F(6,25):math.floor(F(value)/g+F(1,2))*g
extra={}
for name,f in fonts.items():
 data=Path(f['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
 tables={data[12+i*16:16+i*16].decode('latin1'):struct.unpack_from('>II',data,20+i*16) for i in range(struct.unpack_from('>H',data,4)[0])}
 offset=tables['OS/2'][0];typo=struct.unpack_from('>hhhHH',data,offset+68)
 extra[name]={'sourceSha256':f['sha256'],'sourcePath':f['path'],'upem':f['upem'],'hhea':f['hhea'],
 'OS2':{'sTypoAscender':typo[0],'sTypoDescender':typo[1],'sTypoLineGap':typo[2],'usWinAscent':typo[3],'usWinDescent':typo[4],
 'sxHeight':struct.unpack_from('>h',data,offset+86)[0],'sCapHeight':struct.unpack_from('>h',data,offset+88)[0]},
 'OS2FieldSource':'Signed hhh and unsigned HH at OS/2 +68, sxHeight/sCapHeight signed hh at +86'}
models={}
for c in ev['cases']:
 f=fonts[c['family']];s=F(c['sizeHalfPoints'],2);a=F(f['hhea']['ascender'],f['upem']);d=F(-f['hhea']['descender'],f['upem']);g=F(f['hhea']['lineGap'],f['upem']);n=a+d+g
 observations=[v['metrics']['offset']['observedPt'][0] for v in c['conditions']]
 plans=[('half_point_nearest_0.65',q(s*F(65,100),F(1,2)),[(grid,mode) for grid in [F(1,2),F(1),F(6,25)] for mode in ['nearest','floor','ceil']])]
 plans += [(label,s*ratio,[(F(1,2),'nearest')]) for label,ratio in [('raw_0.65',F(65,100)),('raw_0.66',F(66,100)),('raw_2_over_3',F(2,3))]]
 for size_name,k,rounding_plans in plans:
  for grid,mode in rounding_plans:
   rr=(lambda t:q(t,grid)) if mode=='nearest' else ((lambda t:math.floor(t/grid)*grid) if mode=='floor' else (lambda t:math.ceil(t/grid)*grid))
   forms={'ascent':lambda t:rr(a*t),'ascent_plus_gap':lambda t:rr((a+g)*t),'natural_minus_descent':lambda t:rr(n*t)-rr(d*t),'ascent_descent_minus_descent':lambda t:rr((a+d)*t)-rr(d*t)}
   if size_name!='half_point_nearest_0.65':forms.pop('ascent_descent_minus_descent');forms['typo_ascent']=lambda t:rr(F(extra[c['family']]['OS2']['sTypoAscender'],f['upem'])*t)
   for form,fn in forms.items():
    key=f'{size_name}/{form}/{grid}/{mode}'
    rec=models.setdefault(key,{'sizeCandidate':size_name,'metricGridPt':float(grid),'metricRounding':mode,'supForm':form,'supPass':0,'subPass':0,'conditions':42,'rows':[]})
    preds=[q(fn(s)-fn(k)),q(rr(d*s)-rr(d*k))]
    for i,(p,actual) in enumerate(zip(preds,observations)):
     passed=abs(float(p)-actual)<=1e-6
     if passed:rec['supPass' if i==0 else 'subPass']+=1
     rec['rows'].append({'id':c['id'],'subject':'superscript' if i==0 else 'subscript','sourceSizePt':float(s),'metricScriptSizePt':float(k),'predictedPt':float(p),'observedPt':actual,'residualPt':actual-float(p),'state':'OK' if passed else 'FAIL'})
ct=json.loads(Path('/tmp/vertical-coretext-probe.json').read_text());tk=json.loads(Path('/tmp/vertical-textkit-probe.json').read_text())
tk_checks=[]
for rec in tk:
 c=next(c for c in ev['cases'] if fonts[c['family']]['postscript']==rec['font'] and c['sizeHalfPoints']/2==rec['size'])
 subject='superscript' if rec['script']==1 else 'subscript';obs=next(z['metrics']['offset']['observedPt'][0] for z in c['conditions'] if z['subject']==subject)
 predicted=float(q(F(str(abs(rec['rise'])))))
 tk_checks.append({'id':c['id'],'subject':subject,'suppliedSmall':rec['suppliedSmall'],'predictedPt':predicted,'observedPt':obs,'state':'OK' if abs(predicted-obs)<1e-6 else 'FAIL'})
result={'schema':'rsword-layout-offset-exploration/1','backtest':True,'status':'EXPLORATORY_ALL_COMPLETE_MODELS_REJECTED','epsPt':1e-6,
 'scope':'Already observed 0e785f8 vertical-precision fixture, same 21 cases/42 conditions. No Word call, no modified capture or frozen evaluator.',
 'inputs':{name:{'path':str(p),'sha256':digest(p)} for name,p in [('evaluation',out/'evaluation-01.json'),('fontInputs',root/'fixtures/vertical-precision.font-inputs.json')]},
 'fontMetrics':extra,'method':'Mechanism-driven candidate enumeration, not fitted family constants. Rounding/metric/size alternatives were selected after inspecting observations; all evaluated combinations and failures retained. This is not preregistration.',
 'candidateFamily':{'scriptSize':'Q0.5(.65*S), or raw .65*S/.66*S/(2/3)*S controls','sup':'Q0.24(M(S)-M(scriptSize))','sub':'Q0.24(R(descent*S/upem)-R(descent*scriptSize/upem))','M':'R(ascent), R(ascent+lineGap), R(natural)-R(descent), or listed control','rounding':'R grid 0.5/1/0.24 and nearest/floor/ceil; raw-size controls only 0.5 nearest','newParameterFit':False,'count':len(models)},
 'models':models,'coreText':{'script':Path('/tmp/vertical-coretext-probe.c').read_text(),'scriptSha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-coretext-probe.c'),'binarySha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-coretext-probe'),'readingsSha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-coretext-probe.json'),'rows':ct,'finding':'For all 63 font-size-script calls, CT run origin is [0,0], text matrix identity, font size unchanged. kCTSuperscript alone does not recreate Word behavior here.','localHeader':'/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreText.framework/Headers/CTStringAttributes.h:200'},
 'textKit':{'script':Path('/tmp/vertical-textkit-probe.m').read_text(),'scriptSha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-textkit-probe.m'),'binarySha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-textkit-probe'),'readingsSha256':digest('/tmp/vertical-textkit-probe.json'),'rows':tk,'comparisons':tk_checks,'finding':'NSSuperscript shifts without shrinking; explicit Q0.5(.65*S) font supplied is a separate control. Neither path explains all Word offsets.'},
 'conclusion':'No replacement rise/drop rule established. Descent metric-difference candidate passes 20/21 subscript cases but fails Arial 8.5 pt; ascent-side variants remain substantially incomplete. Frozen engine ratios should not be replaced from this backtest.'}
(out/'offset-exploration.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('models',len(models));print('font inputs sha',digest(root/'fixtures/vertical-precision.font-inputs.json'))
for name in ['vertical-coretext-probe.c','vertical-textkit-probe.m']:print(name,digest('/tmp/'+name))
print('textkit',[(k,sum(r['state']=='OK' for r in tk_checks if r['suppliedSmall']==k)) for k in [False,True]])
